content.text: CYP2D6 inhibitors (eg, quinidine, cimetidine) can make a patient stable on a TCA abruptly toxic; the combination may need lower doses of the TCA or the other drug.

get an ECG, start cardiac monitoring and observe for at least six hours; a limb-lead QRS of 0.10 seconds or more may best show severity; give IV sodium bicarbonate to keep serum pH at 7.45 to 7.55. Type 1A and 1C antiarrhythmics are generally contraindicated.
